Our challenging offer

If you believe that your Migraine is not curable, come to us, we will cure you. You can even pay after getting the result (no need to pay in the beginning of treatment) for more details regarding this offer visit our challenging offer page.

Medicine

We are using pure Ayurvedic/herbal/natural medicines for the treatment of Migraine. We have our patented medicines for the treatment of the same. We have our own Medicine Manufacturing unit, having GMP Certificate. We use quality materials for the manufacture of these quality medicines.

Duration of the treatment

Normally more than 95% of the patients will be cured within three weeks, others may take some more time. Everybody have to continue the medications for at least 6 months. Rare cases the duration may increase.

 Benefits of our treatment

  1. More than 80% of the patients can live without painkiller (if they are using one) in the first day of our treatment itself; others can leave the painkiller within 2 or 3 days.
  2. More than 95% people will be cured within 3 weeks time.  Others may take some more time.  The speed of recovery depends on many factors including the severity of the problem, the age of the patient, how long the patient is suffering from Migraine, other medicines they are using to treat other ailments, and to what extent they are following the instructions given by us.
  3. Our medications for Migraine will help to remove the inflammation and infection if any.
  4. The medications will also  remove toxins from the body and increase your immune power.

What is  Migraine

Migraine: is a chronic disorder characterized by moderate to severe headaches. The headaches are often one sided and associated with nausea, vomiting, sensitivity to light, sound and smell, sleep disruption and depression. It is considered to be a neurovascular disorder.
